title: Tenant authorization continuity
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Change destinations for two tenants; select assertions that expose cross-tenant access while checking that authorized permissions are retained.
preconditions: Alba and Birch each have a synthetic member and record; each member may read only its own tenant's record.
v1 and v2 remain directly reachable before and after the change; both are isolated before the change.
Both tenants initially route to v1. v1 stays isolated after the change.
This is an in-memory deterministic policy fixture, not real authentication or authorization against a service.
actions: Choose the after-change v1 or v2 destination independently for each tenant.
Choose v2's after-change isolated, allow-foreign, wrong-data, deny-own, or unobserved policy.
Select own-read permission, foreign-read rejection, and data-tenant assertions.
Run the fixed before/after matrix, inspect every routed/direct observation, retain history, and reset explicitly.

syntheticInput.storage: Memory only; reload or explicit reset clears history.

expectedAssertions: Own reads retain a synthetic 200 response.
Foreign reads are explicitly rejected with synthetic 403 and no data.
Own-read data belongs to the requested tenant.
Missing observations or omitted applicable assertions are UNKNOWN, never success.
Observed selected assertion failures take precedence over unknown coverage.
Every reachable version is probed, even if not selected by a tenant's route.

results.success: All 16 probe outcomes succeed; verifier PASS is limited to this synthetic matrix.
results.failure: At least one observed selected assertion fails; verifier FAIL.
results.unknown: No selected assertion fails but at least one observation or required assertion is missing; verifier UNVERIFIED.

limits: No cloud, IaC, server, lease, authentication, identity registration, credentials, deployment or spending.
No timers, randomness, network, browser storage, user-supplied URLs or arbitrary policy code.
No retirement or native-platform proof; a healthy direct endpoint does not imply both tenants migrated.
Node22, offline Playwright1.56.1 and signed Edge156 qualify local test tooling only; not production24 or five-nines reliability.
B-S038 and the original source-parent gates remain incomplete.
